dimensions.evidenceA: Jesus speaks to crowds about receiving John as Elijah who is to come.
dimensions.evidenceB: John answers a direct identity question from priests and Levites.
dimensions.label: Question and answer

dimensions.evidenceA: The statement includes “if you are willing to receive it.”
dimensions.evidenceB: The denial is followed by John naming himself as a wilderness voice.
dimensions.label: Qualification

evidence.observation: Jesus says, “If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.”
When asked, “Are you Elijah?” John answers, “I am not.”

record.tension: Jesus’ statement and John’s answer use Elijah identity language differently.
record.title: Is John identified as Elijah?
